country_queries.Ethiopia: (Ethiopia OR Ethiopian OR Tigray OR Amhara)
country_queries.Sudan: (Sudan OR Sudanese OR Darfur OR Kordofan)
country_queries.Somalia: (Somalia OR Somali OR Mogadishu OR Puntland)

topics.humanitarian: (humanitarian OR refugees OR refugee OR displacement OR displaced OR hunger OR famine OR malnutrition OR drought OR flooding OR cholera)
topics.security: (military OR armed OR fighting OR clashes OR troops OR insurgency OR war OR attacks)

restrictions: Keep identical media collections/sources for all three searches
Keep identical publication start and end dates and identical provider
Use a clearly stated language scope (not assumed identical to GDELT)
Counts refer to Media Cloud-indexed news, not the entire world media
Do not add humanitarian and security shares, as they overlap
Missing daily intervals are not automatically zeros
Sudan may include South Sudan, manually audit precision
fallback_scope: Pilot Ethiopia, no numerical findings until export files pass validation
